posts.name: Katrina Kaif
posts.caption: Katrina Kaif remains in Bollywood's top 5 stars per fresh Ormax data despite no release in over two years, while fans keep gushing over her wholesome family glimpses with Vicky Kaushal and baby Vihaan.

posts.name: Diljit Dosanjh
posts.caption: Diljit Dosanjh's Partition drama 'Main Vaapas Aaunga,' directed by Imtiaz Ali, hit theatres on June 12 and is drawing praise even as it battles 'Haunted' and 'Bharat Bhhagya Viddhaata' at the box office.

posts.name: Alia Bhatt
posts.caption: Alia Bhatt penned a heartfelt birthday note for her 'Alpha' co-star Sharvari, sharing an unseen piano video, as the YRF spy-universe thriller's teaser builds anticipation.

posts.name: Priyanka Chopra
posts.caption: Priyanka Chopra launched a new homeware line in the US and gifted matching sneakers to Nick Jonas and daughter Malti for Father's Day, sharing a sweet note with fans.

posts.name: Shah Rukh Khan
posts.caption: Shah Rukh Khan's much-anticipated action film 'King,' co-starring daughter Suhana Khan and Deepika Padukone, is now being discussed as a possible two-part release amid Bollywood's post-'Dhurandhar' shift to mega-scale storytelling.

posts.name: Kareena Kapoor Khan
posts.caption: Kareena Kapoor Khan has wrapped the shoot of Meghna Gulzar's 'Daayra' opposite Prithviraj Sukumaran, and is reportedly in the running to lead Salman Khan's superhero film directed by Raj & DK.

posts.name: Shraddha Kapoor
posts.caption: Shraddha Kapoor's upcoming film 'Eetha' has locked an August 28, 2026 release, setting up a box-office clash with Sidharth Malhotra's 'Vvan,' amid reports she suffered an injury on set.

posts.name: Deepika Padukone
posts.caption: Deepika Padukone, expecting her second child, set off fresh speculation over her fallout with director Sandeep Reddy Vanga after a candid interview in Stockholm about standing by tough decisions.

posts.name: Ranveer Singh
posts.caption: Ranveer's Dhurandhar franchise keeps shattering box office records, with the first installment now set for a July 10 Japan release, even as the FWICE non-cooperation row over his Don 3 exit rumbles on.

posts.name: Aishwarya Rai Bachchan
posts.caption: Aishwarya is back in the spotlight with another head-turning Cannes 2026 red carpet appearance alongside daughter Aaradhya, drawing both praise and the usual social-media chatter.

posts.name: Rashmika Mandanna
posts.caption: Rashmika's Cocktail 2 has been passed with an 'A' certificate, marking her second adult-rated film after Animal, while she continues prepping her intense new avatar for Mysaa.

posts.name: Samantha Ruth Prabhu
posts.caption: Samantha firmly shut down rumors that she took Rs 25 crore from a Telugu superstar for her myositis treatment, urging people to be responsible, as her film Maa Inti Bangaaram gears up for release.

posts.name: Allu Arjun
posts.caption: Allu Arjun showered praise on cousin Ram Charan's 'gritty and raw' Peddi performance, while buzz builds around his upcoming films Raaka with Atlee and AA23 with Lokesh Kanagaraj.

posts.name: Ram Charan
posts.caption: Ram Charan and Upasana shared the first photo of their twins Shivram and Anveera Devi, even as his blockbuster Peddi roars past Rs 200 crore in India despite controversy over Janhvi Kapoor's scenes.

posts.name: Jr NTR
posts.caption: Jr NTR is generating massive buzz with Prashanth Neel's pan-India epic Dragon, and is reportedly in talks with Hi Nanna director Shouryuv for a two-part action drama.

posts.name: Janhvi Kapoor
posts.caption: Janhvi is at the center of the Peddi controversy, with the film's director apologizing and trimming scenes over objectification backlash, even as co-stars and peers rally to defend her performance.

posts.name: Ananya Panday
posts.caption: Ananya Panday's romantic drama 'Chaand Mera Dil' with Lakshya continues its theatrical run, and she's been sharing vacation snaps while teasing fans about shooting 'something really fun and exciting' next.

posts.name: Kiara Advani
posts.caption: Kiara Advani and husband Sidharth Malhotra have welcomed their first child, a baby girl, and asked fans for privacy as they cherish the moment.

posts.name: Hrithik Roshan
posts.caption: Hrithik Roshan is reportedly being approached for a cameo in 'Jailer 2', potentially reuniting him with Rajinikanth, while 'War 2' with Jr NTR keeps breaking box-office records.

posts.name: Varun Dhawan
posts.caption: Varun Dhawan's rom-com 'Hai Jawani Toh Ishq Hona Hai' is showing strong holds in its second week, eyeing a Rs 60 crore-plus lifetime, with the actor crediting co-stars Mrunal Thakur and Pooja Hegde for its success.

posts.name: Shreya Ghoshal
posts.caption: Shreya Ghoshal recently dropped the 'Nabz Nabz (Female Version)' track and lent her voice to 'Chaand Mera Dil', as she gears up for World Music Day performances.

posts.name: AR Rahman
posts.caption: AR Rahman is in the spotlight as 'Lagaan' marks its 25th anniversary, and he's set to mentor a London Symphony Orchestra premiere of Lydian Nadhaswaram's debut symphony on World Music Day, June 21.

posts.name: Vijay Thalapathy
posts.caption: Thalapathy Vijay's swan-song film 'Jana Nayagan' faces fresh release-date uncertainty and distribution reworking, holding extra significance as his first release since becoming Tamil Nadu Chief Minister.
